prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1198; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured vehicle contacted the left rear quarter panel of the claimant vehicle. Both drivers reported to be stopped on the shoulder at time of contact. Initial photos requested from both parties and police report number pending.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness beginning later the same day, consistent with whiplash. Claimant states they are not represented by an attorney and has not retained anyone to handle the matter. Explained the claims process and that medical documentation will be needed to evaluate the injury component. Claimant agreed to send treatment records when available.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos from both vehicles. Visible damage to claimant's rear driver-side door and quarter panel, with scuffing consistent with a glancing contact. Insured vehicle shows damage to front passenger-side fender. Liability appears likely to rest with the insured, who acknowledged moving into the adjacent lane without confirming the blind spot. Recorded insured's statement.

Entry 4: Claimant provided urgent care visit summary. Diagnosis noted as cervical strain with soft tissue involvement. Physician recommended physical therapy and a follow-up in several weeks. Claimant has not yet submitted receipts for co-pays. Advised claimant to keep all medical bills and mileage records for any travel to appointments.

Entry 5: Followed up with claimant regarding physical therapy schedule. Claimant reports improvement but ongoing discomfort with prolonged driving. Repair estimate for claimant vehicle received and under review. Injury file will remain open pending completion of treatment and receipt of final medical records. Next contact scheduled to confirm therapy progress.
